render_vt_task_simulations: render Virtual Tools task simulations as PNG images with dynamic balls added to each scene
translate_vt_to_phyre: translate a Virtual Tools world JSON into a PHYRE scene using vt_converter.translate_to_phyre
simulate_phyre_scene: simulate a PHYRE scene over time using phyre.simulator.simulate_scene and sample timesteps
rasterize_scene_to_image: rasterize a PHYRE scene state to an image using phyre.simulator.scene_to_raster and convert to RGB
create_dynamic_ball_scene: create a PHYRE scene with a dynamic ball added at specified coordinates and scale
